$comment: Synthetic archive, January 2025 to August 2026. Timestamps are UTC. `first_response_at` is recorded for every vendor that answered a request, including ones that lost the bid, because response speed is learned from every request and not only from won work. Amounts are strings so they load as Decimal without passing through a float.

cases.title: Stairwell deep clean before the annual meeting
cases.raised_as: The stairwells look rough and we have the annual meeting in three weeks. Can we get a proper clean done, not just the usual sweep?
cases.problem: Accumulated grime in all four stairwells beyond what the three-times-weekly standing arrangement covers.

quotes.scope: Four stairwells, eight flights each, hard floor scrub and handrail degrease.

cases.selection_rationale: Only company asked. They already knew the building from a previous season.
cases.work_performed: Machine scrub of all stairwell floors, handrails degreased, skirting wiped.
cases.resolution_notes: Done in one day. No complaints afterwards.

cases.title: A Block elevator doors reopening repeatedly
cases.raised_as: A Block lift doors keep opening and closing before they let you go. Took four tries this morning and it was full.
cases.problem: Door safety edge triggering with no obstruction, causing repeated reopen cycles and long dwell times at each floor.

quotes.scope: Door sensor alignment, safety edge test, labour and travel.
Door sensor adjustment.

cases.selection_rationale: Coastline had not answered when the decision was made, and a full cabin failing to depart was treated as urgent.
cases.work_performed: Photocell pair realigned, safety edge cleaned and function tested across all eight stops.
cases.resolution_notes: Meridian noted the door controller is the discontinued original and suggested budgeting for a replacement within two years.

cases.title: B Block elevator emergency phone dead
cases.raised_as: Tested the emergency phone in B Block during the inspection walk. Completely dead. This one we cannot leave.
cases.problem: Cabin emergency telephone not connecting. A statutory requirement, so the elevator is technically not compliant while it is out.

quotes.scope: Emergency phone line test, handset replacement if required, connection certificate.

cases.selection_rationale: Compliance item on a contract they already hold. No competitive request made.
cases.work_performed: Handset replaced, line re-terminated at the shaft junction box, two-way call tested from cabin.
cases.resolution_notes: Cause was a corroded terminal, not the handset. Meridian replaced both anyway at the quoted price.

cases.title: Spring planting for the front entrance beds
cases.raised_as: The front beds are bare and it is April. If we want anything flowering by June it needs to go in now.
cases.problem: Seasonal replanting of the two entrance beds and the courtyard border.

quotes.scope: Clear and turn both entrance beds, supply and plant perennials plus seasonal colour, mulch, two follow-up visits.

cases.selection_rationale: Existing grounds contractor. Elena V. reviewed the plant list and approved it in the chat.
cases.work_performed: Beds cleared and turned, 140 plants supplied and planted, bark mulch laid.
cases.resolution_notes: Greenline was slow to quote, two days, which they attributed to spring workload. Work itself was on time.

cases.title: Annual statutory inspection, all four elevators
cases.raised_as: Annual lift inspection is due. Booking it with Meridian as usual.
cases.problem: Scheduled statutory inspection of all four elevators.

quotes.scope: Statutory annual inspection and certification, four units.

cases.selection_rationale: Held under the standing inspection arrangement.
cases.work_performed: Four units inspected and certified. A Block door controller flagged as obsolete for the second time.
cases.resolution_notes: Planned work. Excluded from failure statistics.

cases.title: C Block elevator stopping mid-morning in warm weather
cases.raised_as: C Block lift has stopped three mornings running, always around eleven, always when it is hot. Works again after an hour.
cases.problem: Thermal cut-out tripping in the machine room. The room faces west and exceeded 40C on warm mornings, shutting the drive down until it cooled.

quotes.scope: Portable extraction unit and temporary ducting for the summer, removal in autumn.
Permanent wall-mounted extraction fan, thermostat control, grille, electrical connection and commissioning.

cases.selection_rationale: Pinnacle proposed a permanent fix where Meridian offered a seasonal one. Elena V. argued in the chat that paying every summer was worse than paying once, and the committee agreed.
cases.work_performed: Extraction fan installed through the west wall with thermostat set to 28C, external grille fitted, spur taken from the machine room board.
cases.resolution_notes: Highest invoice of any elevator job that year and there has not been a heat stoppage since, across two summers. Pinnacle's only job on this property.

cases.title: Pool opening for the season
cases.raised_as: Pool needs to be ready for the long weekend. Water is green.
cases.problem: Seasonal opening: shock treatment, filter clean, chemistry balance, safety check.

quotes.scope: Drain to waste, shock, filter backwash and media check, chemistry balance, handover test.

cases.selection_rationale: Standing seasonal arrangement.
cases.work_performed: Shock treatment, backwash, chemistry balanced, pool released for use.
cases.resolution_notes: Ready two days before the weekend.

cases.title: A Block elevator stopped between floors three and four with a resident inside
cases.raised_as: I was stuck in the A Block lift for about twenty minutes just now with the stroller. Doors would not open at three or four. Someone got me out with the key. Please do something about this one.
cases.problem: Elevator halted between floors with the door lock circuit reading open. A resident was inside and was released manually.

quotes.scope: Out-of-hours attendance, door lock contact replacement using a refurbished assembly, full safety circuit test.
Door lock assembly replacement, new part.
Door lock inspection and adjustment, replacement if needed.

cases.selection_rationale: Only company willing to attend the same evening. Someone had been trapped, so price was not the deciding factor. Coastline's answer arrived a day and a half after the lift was already running.
cases.work_performed: Landing door lock contact on floor three replaced with a refurbished assembly, all eight landing locks tested, safety circuit continuity verified.
cases.resolution_notes: Meridian disclosed the part was refurbished before fitting it and priced it accordingly. The trapped-resident incident is the reason the committee later set the elevator per-incident cap as high as 1500.

cases.title: Annual fire alarm inspection
cases.raised_as: Fire alarm inspection is due this month.
cases.problem: Statutory annual inspection of the addressable panel and all detectors across four blocks.

quotes.scope: Panel inspection, detector test across four blocks, certification, minor remedials.

cases.selection_rationale: Sole provider used for this asset.
cases.work_performed: Panel inspected, 112 detectors tested, four replaced, certificate issued.
cases.resolution_notes: Compliance work. Never delegated to an agent regardless of how routine it looks.

cases.title: Repeated arguments about reserved parking spaces
cases.raised_as: This is the fourth time this month someone has parked in a space that is not theirs and the chat has turned into an argument again. Can we actually settle this.
cases.problem: A dispute between residents rather than a fault. No vendor involved and nothing to procure.
cases.work_performed: A residents' meeting was called for 22 July. A numbering scheme and a written rule for visitor spaces were agreed and posted in all four lobbies.
cases.resolution_notes: Included in the archive because Steward must be able to recognise a problem that needs a meeting and an announcement rather than a contractor. Disputes between residents are set to escalate only, so the agent drafts the notice and a human decides whether to send it.

cases.title: C Block elevator door rubber strip torn
cases.raised_as: The rubber strip on the C Block lift door is hanging off. Not dangerous, just looks bad and catches.
cases.problem: Cosmetic and minor mechanical: torn door edge rubber catching on the frame.

quotes.scope: Supply and fit replacement door edge rubber, one leaf.

cases.selection_rationale: Small cosmetic job where the cheapest bidder was a reasonable choice.
cases.work_performed: Door edge rubber replaced on the leading leaf.
cases.resolution_notes: Held. The one Coastline job on this property that did not come back, which matters: their record is poor but not uniformly poor, and the scorecard should show a rate rather than a verdict.

cases.title: Pool circulation pump leaking at the seal
cases.raised_as: There is water on the pump room floor and the pump is whining. Turned it off at the isolator.
cases.problem: Mechanical seal on the single circulation pump failed, leaking to the plant room floor. Pool unusable while the pump is off in peak season.

quotes.scope: Mechanical seal kit, labour, pressure test and chemistry recheck.

cases.selection_rationale: Seasonal provider, knows the plant, peak season made speed the priority.
cases.work_performed: Mechanical seal replaced, impeller inspected, system pressure tested and chemistry rebalanced.
cases.resolution_notes: Two days out of use in August. Bluewater recommended budgeting for a standby pump; nobody wrote that down and it was not raised again.

cases.title: Main gate barrier arm will not lower
cases.raised_as: Gate barrier is stuck upright since last night. Anyone can drive in.
cases.problem: Barrier arm remained raised, leaving the only vehicle entrance uncontrolled overnight.

quotes.scope: Attend, diagnose drive fault, replace limit switch, test cycle.

cases.selection_rationale: Installed the system and is the only practical supplier for it.
cases.work_performed: Failed lower limit switch replaced, barrier cycle tested twenty times.
cases.resolution_notes: Same day. Being the sole supplier for this asset is worth remembering when reading their prices.

cases.title: B Block elevator stopping about three centimetres low at the ground floor
cases.raised_as: B Block lift is stopping low at the ground floor. It is a step, not a big one, but you notice it with shopping.
cases.problem: Levelling error of roughly 30 mm at the ground floor landing.

quotes.scope: Investigate levelling error at source, check encoder and shaft sensors, recalibrate.
Adjust ground floor levelling sensor.

cases.selection_rationale: Cheapest quote and a 30 mm step was not treated as urgent. Nobody compared what the two quotes actually proposed to do.
cases.work_performed: Ground floor levelling sensor adjusted. Cabin stopped flush on handover.
cases.resolution_notes: The quotes were not comparable and were compared on price anyway. Meridian offered to find the cause; Coastline offered to adjust the symptom. The symptom returned in eleven weeks.

cases.title: Garage lighting circuit two tripping repeatedly
cases.raised_as: Half the garage is dark again. The breaker keeps going. It is genuinely unsafe walking to the far bays.
cases.problem: RCD on garage lighting circuit two tripping several times a day, leaving roughly half the garage unlit.

quotes.scope: Insulation resistance testing of circuit two, locate fault, repair or replace affected fittings, retest.

cases.selection_rationale: Safety issue and the only electrical contractor on the approved list.
cases.work_performed: Water ingress found at two fittings under a cracked service duct. Fittings replaced with sealed units, duct joint sealed, circuit retested.
cases.resolution_notes: Diagnosed as ingress rather than overload, which is why it has not returned. A cheaper response would have been to reset the breaker.

cases.title: Tree limb overhanging D Block balconies
cases.raised_as: The big limb over the D Block balconies is scraping the railings when it is windy. It does this every autumn and every autumn we forget about it.
cases.problem: Mature tree limb in contact with third and fourth floor balcony railings in wind.

quotes.scope: Reduce two limbs on the courtyard lime, chip and remove arisings, platform hire.

cases.selection_rationale: Grounds contractor, has the platform access arrangement.
cases.work_performed: Two limbs reduced by roughly two metres, cuts sealed, arisings chipped and removed.
cases.resolution_notes: Mei-Ling C.'s phrase, that this happens every autumn and is forgotten every autumn, is the reason this project exists. The regrowth is predictable and nothing in the community's process anticipates it.

cases.title: A Block elevator vibrating and noisy on the way up
cases.raised_as: A Block lift has started shuddering on the way up, somewhere around the fourth floor, and there is a grinding noise with it. Going down is fine.
cases.problem: Vibration and noise on ascent between the fourth and fifth floors, absent on descent.

quotes.scope: Inspect guide rails and shoes over the full travel, check rail alignment and fixings, replace shoes and correct alignment as found.
Replace guide shoes.

cases.selection_rationale: Cheapest quote. The committee was 8,900 into an 11,000 annual maintenance budget and Ingrid B. said in the chat that they needed to hold the line until January.
cases.work_performed: Guide shoes replaced on the car frame. Coastline reported the rails as within tolerance.
cases.resolution_notes: Vibration gone on handover. Returned after seven weeks. The rails were not within tolerance, and the January recall found two misaligned brackets in the same stretch of travel.

cases.title: B Block elevator levelling error returned and worse
cases.raised_as: I tripped getting out of the B Block lift this morning. The step is worse than it was. I think this is the same thing that was fixed in September.
cases.problem: Ground floor levelling error returned at roughly 50 mm, eleven weeks after being adjusted. Now a trip hazard.

quotes.scope: Investigate cause under load, encoder test and replacement if drifting, full levelling recalibration across all stops.
Re-adjust ground floor levelling sensor.

cases.selection_rationale: Coastline quoted lowest again and proposed re-adjusting the same sensor they had adjusted in September. Hannah W. pointed this out in the chat. The committee paid more than double to have the cause found instead of the symptom re-adjusted.
cases.work_performed: Shaft encoder found drifting under load and replaced. Levelling recalibrated at all eight stops.
cases.resolution_notes: The September sensor adjustment had masked a failing encoder. No levelling complaint on B Block since. Total spent on this fault across both attempts was 1,370 against Meridian's original 610 quote in September.

cases.title: Upper floors losing water pressure in the evenings
cases.raised_as: Seventh and eighth floor showers are a trickle between seven and nine in the evening. Been like this about a week.
cases.problem: Duty booster pump losing output under evening peak demand, leaving upper floors short of pressure.

quotes.scope: Pressure survey, strip and overhaul duty pump, replace worn impeller and diaphragm vessel, rebalance duty and standby changeover.

cases.selection_rationale: Only approved plumbing contractor and the problem was affecting two floors daily.
cases.work_performed: Duty pump impeller replaced, expansion vessel replaced, changeover sequence rebalanced so both pumps share duty.
cases.resolution_notes: Expensive for one visit and it held. No pressure complaints since.

cases.title: A Block elevator vibration returned seven weeks after repair
cases.raised_as: The A Block shudder is back. Same place, same noise. This was supposedly fixed in November.
cases.problem: The vibration repaired in November returned in the same stretch of travel.

quotes.scope: Return visit under goodwill, no charge.

cases.selection_rationale: Recalled to their own work rather than treated as a new job.
cases.work_performed: Two misaligned rail brackets between the fourth and fifth floors corrected. Guide shoes replaced again.
cases.resolution_notes: Coastline attended at no charge and this time adjusted the rails, which they had reported as within tolerance in November. Hannah W. said so in the chat and was right. The committee agreed verbally to stop defaulting to the lowest elevator quote. Nothing was written down anywhere a future committee would find it, and that is precisely the gap this project addresses. Recorded as a recall, so it is excluded from job counts and cost averages while still marking the November case as failed.

cases.title: Emergency exit lights failing self-test in two stairwells
cases.raised_as: Two of the exit lights in B and C stairwells are showing red on the self test. Assuming that means the batteries are gone.
cases.problem: Emergency luminaire batteries at end of life in two stairwells.

quotes.scope: Replace battery packs in six luminaires, run and log discharge test.

cases.selection_rationale: Approved electrical contractor, small predictable job.
cases.work_performed: Six battery packs replaced, three hour discharge test run and logged.
cases.resolution_notes: Held.

cases.title: Garage floor oil staining
cases.raised_as: The garage floor is badly stained and it is starting to get tracked into the lobbies. Worth doing properly once.
cases.problem: Accumulated oil staining across the garage deck, transferring into lobbies on shoes.

quotes.scope: Degrease and machine scrub the full garage deck in two halves over one weekend so bays stay usable.

cases.selection_rationale: Known contractor, and the phased approach avoided closing the garage.
cases.work_performed: Deck degreased and scrubbed in two halves across a weekend.
cases.resolution_notes: Lobby tracking stopped.

cases.title: D Block elevator buttons dead on floors five to eight
cases.raised_as: None of the buttons for five through eight do anything in the D Block lift. Lower floors are fine. Had to ride up with a neighbour and walk down.
cases.problem: Car operating panel not registering calls for the upper four floors.

quotes.scope: Diagnose car operating panel, replace ribbon connector or panel board as found, test all calls.
Car operating panel inspection and repair.

cases.selection_rationale: The difference was fifty. After January the committee stopped treating a fifty dollar saving on an elevator as a reason for anything.
cases.work_performed: Corroded ribbon connector behind the car operating panel replaced, panel partially rebuilt, all sixteen calls tested.
cases.resolution_notes: Held.

cases.title: Courtyard irrigation leaking at the manifold
cases.raised_as: There is a wet patch in the courtyard that has not dried for a week and the lawn there is going yellow. I think the irrigation manifold is leaking underground.
cases.problem: Buried irrigation manifold leaking, saturating one area of courtyard lawn.

quotes.scope: Verbal estimate: excavate, repair or replace manifold, reinstate turf.

cases.selection_rationale: Greenline was booked out for three weeks and the lawn was dying. Thornfield gave an estimate over the phone rather than in writing.
cases.work_performed: Manifold excavated and replaced, two cracked laterals renewed, turf reinstated.
cases.resolution_notes: Invoiced 920 against a verbal estimate of 640, argued as unavoidable once the trench was open. The committee paid and removed Thornfield from the approved list. This is why the vendor allowlist exists as a hard gate: a quote from Thornfield now cannot be accepted autonomously no matter how reasonable it looks, and the reason is recorded here rather than in somebody's memory.

cases.title: B Block intercom panel dead
cases.raised_as: B Block intercom is completely dead, no tone, no display. Visitors have been calling our phones instead.
cases.problem: One of four block intercom panels unresponsive; the gate controller and other panels unaffected.

quotes.scope: Panel diagnosis, replace panel board and power supply as found, re-register handsets.

cases.selection_rationale: Sole supplier for the gate system.
cases.work_performed: Failed panel power supply replaced, panel board reseated, all twenty-four handsets re-registered.
cases.resolution_notes: Held.

cases.title: A Block elevator cabin light flickering and doors slow to close
cases.raised_as: A Block cabin light is flickering and the doors are taking their time closing. Nothing dramatic but after last time I would rather say something early.
cases.problem: Cabin luminaire flickering and door operator closing noticeably slower than the other three cars.

quotes.scope: Replace cabin luminaire ballast, inspect and tension door operator belt, check door timing.
Cabin light and door adjustment.

cases.selection_rationale: First A Block case after the January recall where the committee chose the higher quote deliberately and said why in the chat.
cases.work_performed: Cabin luminaire ballast replaced, door operator belt tensioned, door timing reset to specification.
cases.resolution_notes: Attended within eighteen hours of the report. Held.

cases.title: Waste enclosure overflowing before every collection
cases.raised_as: The bin area is overflowing again by Sunday night and it stays like that until Tuesday. Foxes have been in it twice.
cases.problem: Six bins insufficient for weekend volume against a Tuesday and Friday collection schedule. Not a repair and not something a contractor could fix.
cases.work_performed: Municipal collection schedule changed from Tuesday and Friday to Monday and Thursday after a written request from the committee. Two additional bins requested at the same time.
cases.resolution_notes: Took two weeks of back and forth with the council and would have been forgotten twice in that period if Hannah W. had not been keeping her own list. Included in the archive because a meaningful share of shared-living problems are resolved administratively, and an agent that can only buy things would miss them.

cases.title: Hedge and border trim before summer
cases.raised_as: Hedges need their first cut of the season and the front border needs tidying.
cases.problem: Routine seasonal hedge and border maintenance.

quotes.scope: Cut and shape all boundary hedging, weed and edge front border, remove arisings.

cases.selection_rationale: Grounds contractor, routine seasonal work.
cases.work_performed: Hedging cut and shaped, border weeded and edged, arisings removed.
cases.resolution_notes: Routine.

cases.title: Pool filter media past its life
cases.raised_as: Water is not clearing the way it should even after a long backwash. Bluewater mentioned last year that the sand was due.
cases.problem: Sand filter media channelled and past service life, reducing filtration efficiency.

quotes.scope: Strip filter, dispose of old media, supply and load new sand, recommission and balance.

cases.selection_rationale: Seasonal provider. They had flagged this a year earlier, which nobody had recorded.
cases.work_performed: Filter stripped, old media removed, new sand loaded, system recommissioned and chemistry balanced.
cases.resolution_notes: Bluewater had recommended this in August 2025 and it was not written down. A note in the right place would have turned an urgent job in peak season into a planned one in spring.

cases.title: Annual fire alarm inspection
cases.raised_as: Fire alarm inspection due again.
cases.problem: Statutory annual inspection.

quotes.scope: Panel inspection, detector test across four blocks, certification.

cases.selection_rationale: Sole provider for this asset.
cases.work_performed: Panel inspected, 112 detectors tested, two replaced, certificate issued.
cases.resolution_notes: Compliance work, prepare-only by policy.

cases.title: Basement drain backing up in the plant corridor
cases.raised_as: Standing water in the basement plant corridor, smells like drainage. Do not think it is the pumps this time.
cases.problem: Blocked basement gully backing up into the plant corridor.

quotes.scope: Jet and clear basement drainage run, camera survey, clean down affected floor.

cases.selection_rationale: Approved plumbing contractor, attended the same day.
cases.work_performed: Drainage run jetted clear of accumulated silt and wipes, camera surveyed with no structural defect found, floor cleaned down.
cases.resolution_notes: Camera survey recommended a repeat jetting in eighteen months. Recorded here so it becomes a scheduled item rather than a surprise.

cases.title: Annual statutory inspection, all four elevators
cases.raised_as: Annual lift inspection due. Meridian again.
cases.problem: Scheduled statutory inspection of all four elevators.

quotes.scope: Statutory annual inspection and certification, four units.

cases.selection_rationale: Standing inspection arrangement.
cases.work_performed: Four units inspected and certified. A Block door controller flagged as obsolete for the third year running, with a written recommendation to replace it within twelve months.
cases.resolution_notes: Planned work, excluded from failure statistics. The A Block controller recommendation has now been made three times and never actioned, which is the kind of slow-moving item that a group chat cannot hold on to.

cases.title: Pool water cloudy after a hot weekend
cases.raised_as: Pool went cloudy over the weekend. It was very busy on Saturday.
cases.problem: Chlorine demand exceeded by heavy bather load over a hot weekend.

quotes.scope: Shock dose, extended filtration run, chemistry rebalance and clarity check.

cases.selection_rationale: Seasonal provider, routine remedial.
cases.work_performed: Shock dosed, filtration run extended overnight, chemistry rebalanced and clarity confirmed.
cases.resolution_notes: Clear within a day. Bluewater suggested a weekend dosing increase for the rest of the season.
